summary: PR 7383 retired ORPHANED.md markers so orphaning and adoption only require changing the owners array in a family's root metadata.json. It merged after approval from jtracey93.
proposed: The old compliance assertion compared marker files with owner handles from the public module index, which can lag an approved metadata change, as a network-connection validation failure showed.
changed: Get-ModuleList.ps1 now resolves ownership from validated root metadata, including inherited child ownership and team handles. The PR was rebased on 2026-09-23 after #7389 removed the obsolete assertion, and the retired assertion is not reintroduced since the metadata gate enforces ownership validity. A reviewer asked whether to later add badges that look up status from the index, and the author said it could go on the backlog.
rejected: The old marker-versus-index compliance assertion was removed and explicitly not reintroduced or duplicated.
shipped: ORPHANED.md files were dropped and README files updated across about two dozen modules, with changes in utilities/pipelines and utilities/tests.
